topic: SL5b grasp-latch reach vs stale occluded centroid (offline, read-only)

definitions.closing_call: call whose grasp.evidence.checks is non-empty (latch in CLOSING, checks evaluated)
definitions.reach_only: closing call whose only failing check is reach
definitions.geometry_frame: grasp.alignment.geometry_frame; frame f is the observation of call seq f (verified: age 0 calls have geometry_frame = seq-1)
definitions.cf_hand_rel_mm: |p_k - H_k H_g^-1 c_k|: stale centroid c_k moved rigidly with panda_hand from the obs of geometry frame g to call k; p = panda_leftfinger origin; FK from panda_libero.urdf at robot_state (reproduces logged reach_mm, see fk_reach_abs_err_mm_max)
definitions.cf_at_geom_frame_mm: |p_g - c_k|: reach evaluated with the hand pose of the frame where the geometry was observed
definitions.cf_true_moved_mm: |p_k - (c_k + (o_k - o_g))|: stale centroid shifted by the sim displacement of the manipulated object body (ground truth, translation only)
definitions.carried: object body pose in panda_hand frame drifted <= 20 mm since geometry frame AND object moved >= 20 mm (3D) since geometry frame (sim_state_image)
definitions.manipulated_object: free MuJoCo body nearest (3D) to AG3S manipulated centroid at the geometry frame of the first closing call
definitions.lifted_objects_sim: free bodies whose z rose >= 20 mm above their z at call 0 obs
definitions.hold_nearest_body: INFERRED attribution: free MuJoCo body nearest to the violating sphere point (verdict_reasons[].evidence.row.point_m, planned step) at the call's obs
definitions.classification_A: no attach; >=1 reach-only closing call with object occluded, carried by the hand, hand-relative reach <= 120 mm; >=1 gripper<->esdf collision HOLD after the first reach-only refusal whose violating point is nearest to the manipulated object
definitions.classification_rule_v1_lift: first rule (lift >= 20 mm instead of carried); gives the same A/not-A split on all 18 failed episodes

not_measured: No rollout was run; every counterfactual is an offline recomputation from logged q (robot_state), logged centroid and sim_state_image; it does not tell whether the episode would have succeeded after attach.

Hand-relative counterfactual assumes the stale centroid is rigid in the panda_hand frame (translation+rotation); the finger slide of panda_leftfinger is included through q. Validity of rigid carry is checked with sim body drift (obj_in_hand_drift_mm), not with the AG3S point cloud.

HOLD attribution to the held object is inferred (nearest sim body to the violating sphere point at the planned step); the ESDF voxels themselves were not reloaded (calls.npz/geom.npz do not store the ESDF).

Whether HOLDs (vs. the trajopt corrections on non-HOLD calls, see trajopt_violated_calls_after_first_reach_only) are what made the episode miss the task is not separable from these records; 'main failure path' is stated as: refusal -> held object stays obstacle -> HOLD streak to episode end (trailing_hold_streak).
Cause of failure after release in V11AB-A t8 and smoke4-B (class C) is not determined from latch/HOLD records.

RB-Y1: per-call reach with hand-relative counterfactual not recomputed (no RB-Y1 FK done here); only logged checks were counted. Episode outcome mapping server chunk -> client episode by t_step reset only.
